description:
Plan your garden at real dimensions on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Drag plants, trees, ponds, contained fire-pit circles, pergolas, saunas, tool sheds, patios, paths, fences and open-top bin screens onto your plan. Set exact widths, depths, heights and rotation, or start from listed product sizes. Draw your lot boundary and buildings, and HomeGardenStudio flags items that fall outside the boundary, overlap a building or sit too close to a fire pit. These checks are based on what you drew; they aren't a survey.

See every change in a top-down plan, an isometric drawing and a 3D view you can orbit. All three run on your device and never use credit.

Import photos, files and product links. Originals are kept unchanged inside your plan, with their source recorded. Calibrate a top-down photo with two points and a known distance before using it to place things. An uncalibrated photo is labelled as not to scale and can't mark anything as measured.

Optional cloud renderings turn your layout and, with your permission for each request, a source photo into a photorealistic concept. The app shows the exact cost before you confirm, and each rendering is labelled as an AI concept, not a measured plan. Use the included credit or your own OpenAI key. Anthropic keys and Apple Intelligence, where your device supports it, help with planting ideas and layout feedback.

Free to download: every view and tool, up to 12 features per plan, and your plans always stay openable and exportable. Unlock on iPhone and iPad for US $1.99 or on Mac for US $3.99, each with $2 of rendering credit, or get both for US $4.99 with $5 of rendering credit. Owners of the iPhone and iPad unlock can upgrade to both platforms for US $3.00, which adds $5 of credit. Restoring purchases never adds credit twice.

Undo and redo every change. Plans are portable files you can share or move between devices. No accounts with your name or email, no tracking.
promotionalText: Lay out your garden at real size, then see it in plan, isometric and 3D, all on your device.
